description: Curated Model Context Protocol server catalog for the All-Skills universal installer. Every entry is installable with one command into any supported harness; entries are grouped into tiers so a default install stays small and 'full' gives an agent access to everything.

tiers.core: Keyless, universally useful servers. Safe for every project and installed by the `core` profile.
tiers.standard: Keyless or single-token servers that cover the most common engineering workflows. Installed by the `standard` profile.
tiers.full: Everything in the catalog, including credentialed SaaS connectors and vendor-specific servers. Installed by the `full` profile.
